findings.message: No JSON-LD block in the post.
'author' is not on the ficha dentist roster.
Internal link points to a page that is not in the ficha page list.

findings.quote: For mild cases, aligners work safely without a dental professional.
findings.why: Unsupervised aligner treatment contradicts FDA and ADA guidance, which call for evaluation and monitoring by a licensed dental professional, and it contradicts the post's own later advice.
findings.fix: Delete the sentence or replace it with: 'Even for mild cases, aligners should be planned and monitored by a licensed dental professional.'

findings.quote: Every adult finishes aligner treatment in six weeks.
findings.why: This is a false, absolute treatment-time guarantee; aligner treatment typically takes many months and varies by case, and it contradicts the post's own caveats.
findings.fix: Delete it, or say that treatment length varies and your dentist can estimate it after an evaluation.

findings.why: The ficha's pages list has no /services/clear-aligners page, so this internal link points to a nonexistent page.
findings.fix: Link to /services, which does exist, or remove the link until the page is created.

findings.why: Dr. Priya Shah is not a dentist on the ficha, so the author is unverifiable and may be fabricated.
findings.fix: Use a dentist from the ficha or a verified author, or remove the byline.

findings.why: This URL exposes an internal 'sitecore/content' CMS path that is unlikely to be a live public page, and I could not verify it.
findings.fix: Replace it with the verified public MouthHealthy braces or orthodontic treatment page URL.

findings.why: I cannot verify that this FDA URL resolves, though the path is plausible.
findings.fix: Open the link and confirm it works before publishing.

findings.quote: Clear aligners may be suitable for mild or moderate orthodontic concerns, but they may not effectively treat more complex conditions.
findings.why: This is a general clinical claim with no inline citation, although it is hedged and broadly consistent with mainstream guidance.
findings.fix: Tie it to the cited FDA or ADA source, or attribute it to the dentist's evaluation.

findings.quote: It is possible to consider orthodontic treatment as an adult.
findings.why: The opening sentence is stilted and generic.
findings.fix: Rewrite it, for example: 'Adults can have orthodontic treatment too.'

findings.quote: Dr. Marcus Oyelaran provides family and pediatric dentistry and clear aligners at Bluebonnet Hollow Dental.
findings.why: This matches the ficha, but the post is credited to a non-ficha author and reviewed by Dr. Marsh, whose listed focus does not include aligners.
findings.fix: Have Dr. Oyelaran, or someone verified, review the post, and confirm the byline.

findings.quote: Aligners are usually worn for most of the day, including while sleeping, and removed for meals and drinks other than water.
findings.why: Wear time is typically 20 to 22 hours a day, and 'most of the day' is vague; it is consistent with mainstream guidance but not sourced.
findings.fix: Say to follow the clinician's wear schedule, as the next sentence already does, or cite a source.
